nodes.label: Newsletter opt-in (Send me occasional updates)
nodes.rationale: Subscribe failure does not block the contact message; logs 'contact brevo subscribe error'.

nodes.label: example.html starter campaign email
nodes.rationale: Inline-styled HTML (email-client safe) to be copied per campaign; personalised greeting with FIRSTNAME default 'there'.

nodes.label: Mandatory {{ unsubscribe }} link
nodes.rationale: Brevo requires an unsubscribe link in every campaign.

nodes.label: Brevo contact form email delivery
nodes.rationale: Free tier (300 emails/day); authenticated sender domain reduces spam; Reply-To set to visitor.

nodes.label: Contact form spam protection (honeypot, time trap, rate limit, same-site)
nodes.norm_label: contact form spam protection (honeypot, time trap, rate limit, same-site)
nodes.rationale: Honeypot gives bots fake success; forms under 3 seconds refused; ~5 messages/hour/visitor best effort on serverless; cross-site posts refused; email shown as backup on failure.

nodes.label: Hostinger Email SMTP fallback
nodes.rationale: Used when BREVO_API_KEY is empty and SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS are set.

nodes.label: Contact form error troubleshooting table
nodes.rationale: Maps /api/contact log messages (no provider configured, missing MAIL_FROM/MAIL_TO, HTTP 401/400) to fixes; recommends disabling Brevo IP blocking because Vercel IPs change.

nodes.label: Brevo email campaign workflow (npm run campaign)
nodes.norm_label: brevo email campaign workflow (npm run campaign)
nodes.rationale: Campaigns are created/scheduled/sent from the owner's computer so the API key never reaches the browser; supports draft, --schedule, --send-now, --lists, --template.

nodes.label: Per-section CSS class prefixes (jr-, jrh-, jre-, jrw-, jrl-, jra-, jrc-, jrm-)
nodes.norm_label: per-section css class prefixes (jr-, jrh-, jre-, jrw-, jrl-, jra-, jrc-, jrm-)
nodes.rationale: All styles live in app/globals.css; a class prefix per section namespaces styles without a CSS framework.

nodes.label: Email environment variables (BREVO_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM, MAIL_TO, BREVO_LIST_ID, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
nodes.norm_label: email environment variables (brevo_api_key, mail_from, mail_to, brevo_list_id, smtp_user, smtp_pass)

nodes.label: Portrait cutout (public/john_rodney_cutout.png)
nodes.rationale: Without it, About section falls back to profile photo in an arch frame.

nodes.label: Vercel deployment
nodes.rationale: Env vars apply only to new deployments, so redeploy after changes; keep MX records in Hostinger hPanel when adding a custom domain.

nodes.label: Zero-dependency design (no Tailwind, no UI kit, no email package)
nodes.norm_label: zero-dependency design (no tailwind, no ui kit, no email package)
nodes.rationale: Only Next.js 16 + React 19; styles are hand-written CSS with hardcoded hex colours; Brevo client uses plain fetch and SMTP fallback uses Node tls to avoid SDK/package dependencies.
